hook: Josh Wander orchestrated a massive $500 million fraud scheme before pleading guilty in federal court.

sections.voiceover: Josh Wander orchestrated a massive $500 million fraud scheme before pleading guilty in federal court.
Federal prosecutors stated that 777 Partners bilked lenders out of funds before collapsing. Miami became the base of operations for the firm. Where did the $500 million disappear?
Josh Wander agreed to pay back every dollar of the losses.
Manhattan federal court recorded the guilty plea for wire fraud. 777 Partners collapsed under massive debts. The 45 year old founder faces severe consequences.
Josh Wander admitted to securities fraud in New York.
